title: Yugo Aosaki's Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Live-Action Series With Worldwide Distribution on Amazon Prime Video
content: Amazon Prime Video announced on Monday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a live-action adaptation titled Rock Paper Landmine that will stream on the service worldwide starting on November 13. The show will star Nana Mori as Mato Imoriya and Aju Makita as Kazahi Koda.
author: ANN

title: Adventure Time: Side Quests Beats The Original Series At Its Own Game
content: Ever since Adventure Time debuted on Cartoon Network in 2010, the franchise has become a monolith for the cable network. Garnering over two hundred and eighty episodes in its original run, the Land of Oooo refused to die as multiple side stories were created.
author: ComicBook

title: Kemono Jihen Manga Goes on Hiatus After Brother of Creator Shō Aimoto Dies
content: The 25th compiled book volume, which shipped on August 4, revealed that the series will end in the next volume. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English and describes the story: Inugami is a Tokyo detective who specializes in the occult.

title: Kotaro Lives Alone Author Mami Tsumura Launches New Manga
content: This year's 18th issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine announced on Friday Mami Tsumura will launch a new manga titled Tanosuke no Kawazanyō (Tanosuke's Overly Optimistic Estimation) in the 19th issue on September 11.
author: ANN

title: Blaze of Flesh and Blood Manga Ends in September
content: The October issue of Ichijinsha 's Comic Zero Sum magazine announced on Friday honomi 's manga adaptation of Hana Yakou 's Blaze of Flesh and Blood ( Rekka no Ketsuzoku ) light novel series will end in the November issue, which ships on September 28.
author: ANN

title: Magical Explorer TV Anime Reveals More Cast, October Debut, Theme Song Artist in Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed on Friday the anime will debut on October 3. The staff also revealed a second key visual, a second promotional video, more cast and staff, and the theme song information.
author: ANN

title: Atelier Resleriana: Forgotten Alchemy and the Polar Night Liberator Smartphone Game Ends Service in Japan on November 25
content: The game debuted for iOS and Android in Japan in September 2023, and launched globally for iOS, Android, and PC via Steam in January 2024. The English version ended service in March 2025.

title: A "New World" Appears in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 46 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 6 (Episode 46 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.
